name: Branch Menu
description: Renders a Drupal menu as a visual branching tree graph.
library_dependencies: d3 (v7, loaded external via jsDelivr CDN)
project_description: Branch Menu is a single-block Drupal 11 module that renders any site menu as a downward-flowing, polygonal tree graph drawn with D3.js (v7, loaded from the jsDelivr CDN). The block plugin (id branch_menu_block, admin label 'Branch Menu Graph', category 'Custom') loads the selected menu's link tree up to 6 levels deep via core's menu.link_tree service, flattens it into a nested title/url/children array, and passes it to the browser through drupalSettings.branchMenu.treeData. The frontend JavaScript (js/branch_menu.js) computes an anti-overlap layout, draws angular SVG branch paths and per-node anchors/labels, while js/branch_animations.js adds hover scale/stroke transitions. Configuration is per block instance: a single 'Select Menu' dropdown chosen in Block layout. The module ships no routes, permissions, config schema, services, or install hooks of its own; it only implements hook_help.
